select
    sg.id 'gid', sg.name 'gname', sg.category_id 'cid', sgc.name 'cname'
from sh_goods sg 
    join sh_goods_category sgc on sg.category_id = sgc.id;

select
    sc.sno 'sno', sc.score 'score'
from course c left join sc on c.cno = sc.cno
where c.cname like '%数据库%' and sc.score between 80 and 90;

select
    c.cno '课程号', c.cname '课程名', count(sc.sno) '选课人数', IFNUll(max(sc.grade),0) '最高成绩',
    IFNUll(min(sc.grade),0) '最低成绩', IFNUll(avg(sc.grade),0) '平均成绩'
from cou c left join sc on c.cno = sc.cno
group by c.cno, c.cname;

select
    s1.*
from Student s1 
where s1.major = (select s2.major from Student s2 where s2.sname = '李勇');

select
    c.CName 'CName', avg(sc.SCScore) 'avg_SCScore'
from course c left join sc on c.CId = sc.CId
where sc.SCScore > 75
group by c.CName;

select s.id 'id', s.name 'name' from
    sh_goods s
    where s.id not in
    (
    select 
        sg.id
    from sh_goods sg join sh_goods_comment sgc on sg.id = sgc.goods_id
    );

select
    e.empno '员工编号',
    e.ename '员工姓名',
    e1.empno '上司编号',
    e1.ename '上司姓名'
from emp e left join emp e1 on e.mgr = e1.empno;

select
    s.sname 'sname',
    ROUND(avg(s1.grade)) 'avggrade'
from student s left join score s1 on s.sno = s1.sno
where s.dept = '数计学院' and s.sname = '叶凡';

select
    cc.class_name '班级名称',
    s.student_id '学号',
    s.name '姓名',
    s.gender '性别',
    c.name '课程名称',
    sc.score '成绩'
from edu_student s
join edu_class cc on s.class_id = cc.class_id
join edu_score sc on s.student_id = sc.student_id
join edu_course c on sc.course_id = c.course_id
where c.name = '数据结构' and s.gender = '女' and sc.score > 85
order by sc.score desc;
